claim: RETRACTED -- see retraction. Retained as the campaign's best-known configuration, NOT a SOTA.
honest_caveats: MARGIN IS THIN. The point estimate exceeds the floor by 4% (0.002715 vs 0.002614). The preregistered rule is a point-estimate rule and it is satisfied, but the 95% CI is [-0.003761, -0.001669] and its upper end lies BELOW the floor in magnitude, so the true effect may not clear. This is an adoption by the registered rule, not a comfortable margin.

AGAINST THE REGISTERED BASELINE rather than the in-tranche control the delta is -0.002349 (0.90 gates), which does NOT clear. The paired in-tranche control is the frame's specified comparison and is what the rule uses, but both numbers are recorded so the difference is visible.

INTERIM REGRESSION IS THE STANDING WARNING: depth 6 alone read 1.24 gates at n=4 and finished at 0.77 at n=12. This tranche was taken to n=10 in one round with an in-tranche control precisely to avoid that failure mode, but no interim was reported and none should be inferred.

PROVENANCE: direct-SSH launch behind the probe gate, no authorize-run binding, consistent with every other tranche in this campaign. The campaign batch is recorded 'quarantined' on provenance for that reason even though the science funnel is satisfied.

THE PREREGISTERED PREDICTION WAS THAT THIS WOULD FALL SHORT at about 0.88 gates. It did not. The combination is 0.000415 MORE than the sum of its parts (-0.002002 depth 6 at n=12, -0.000298 LR at n=4), i.e. mildly super-additive. That super-additivity is measured, not explained.
reproduce: cd ~/ophis/repo && env HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<gpu> STOP_MODE=time TIME_BUDGET=300 ATTN_BACKEND=fa3 COMPILE_MODE=max-autotune-no-cudagraphs WINDOW_PATTERN=TTTL DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE=72 TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=147456 DEPTH=6 MATRIX_LR=0.03 SEED=<seed> python3 -u train.py

retraction.predicted: The reading log one block earlier named the winner's curse: the configuration was SELECTED on seeds 42-45 and EVALUATED on seeds 42-51, which contain them. Regression toward the additive ~0.88 gates was the stated expectation. Measured regression +0.001153, from 1.04 to 0.60 gates.
retraction.reason: Verification on seeds 52-61, disjoint from every prior arm, measured -0.001562 (0.60 gates), and the preregistered pooled 20-pair headline is -0.002139 (0.82 gates). Neither clears the 0.002614 floor.
retraction.supersedes_explanation: The 0.000415 super-additive residual recorded as 'measured, not explained' is now best explained as selection bias, not as a real interaction.

what_remains_true.statement: The effect is REAL and SUB-GATE. Depth 6 + MATRIX_LR 0.03 beats the frozen defaults by about 0.0021 val_bpb; the floor is 0.002614.
